def test_encrypt():

    assert encrypt('hi') == 'lm'
    assert encrypt('asdfghjkl') == 'ewhjklnop'
    assert encrypt('gf') == 'kj'

    # Wrap-around cases (w, x, y, z wrap to a, b, c, d)
    assert encrypt('wxyz') == 'abcd'
    assert encrypt('z') == 'd'

    # Longer string with mixed letters
    assert encrypt('faewfawefaawg') == 'jeiajeiajeeak'

    # Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged
    assert encrypt('HI') == 'HI'
    assert encrypt('123!') == '123!'
    assert encrypt('a1b2') == 'e1f2'
    assert encrypt('') == ''
    assert encrypt(' ') == ' '

    # Double-check property: encrypting twice shifts by 8
    assert encrypt(encrypt('abc')) == 'ijk'

def test_encrypt():

    assert encrypt('hi') == 'lm'
    assert encrypt('asdfghjkl') == 'ewhjklnop'
    assert encrypt('gf') == 'kj'
    assert encrypt('et') == 'ix'

    # Wrap-around at end of alphabet
    assert encrypt('wxyz') == 'abcd'
    assert encrypt('z') == 'd'

    # Longer string with mixed letters
    assert encrypt('hellomyfriend') == 'lippsqcjvmirh'
    assert encrypt('faewfawefaewg') == 'jeiajeaijeiak'

    # Non-alphabetic characters are unchanged
    assert encrypt('Hi!') == 'Hm!'
    assert encrypt('a1b2c3') == 'e1f2g3'
    assert encrypt('ABC') == 'ABC'
    assert encrypt(' !@# ') == ' !@# '

    # Edge cases
    assert encrypt('') == ''
    assert encrypt('a') == 'e'

    # Uppercase letters are not shifted (not in lowercase alphabet)
    assert encrypt('Hello') == 'Lipps' if False else encrypt('Hello') == 'Helso'
